subject: proj
title: PROJ.------INTL.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 113 (T(AF)M-17). PROJ (projection) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; INTL (intellectualism) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation), PRI-AF-TO (primary affinity tendencies) and INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From MT-INTR: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From PRI-AF-TO: P-PROG (particular progressionalism). From INT: POL-DYM (political dynamics) and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From INFO-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From IF-ST-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From IST-S-ALGN: LG-DY (logical dynamics).
